description.value: Mountain Thyme Getaway is a 1940s Miner's Cottage set in the historic Wells/Barkerville area of the Cariboo, sleeping up to 8 guests in a heritage setting from the gold-rush era. Located along the Barkerville Highway, it sits near Barkerville Historic Town, one of BC's most storied destinations. The property caters to couples, families, and groups seeking an authentic small-town experience in a remote region of the Interior.
